Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the genealogy after the WebSurfer showed that William de Beauchamp (Richard’s father) was the son of Thomas de Beauchamp, 11th Earl of Warwick. Instead of identifying Thomas as the paternal grandfather, the Planner incorrectly leapt one generation further back to Guy de Beauchamp (the great-grandfather), confusing titles and generations.
